dimensions.assessment: Affects members of the foundation board, regional review panels, executive staff, and future applicants or recipients of the Truman Scholarship.
dimensions.evidence: This bill makes changes to the Harry S. Truman Scholarship Foundation, which awards scholarships to students who plan to attend graduate school

dimensions.assessment: Recipients face new eligibility restrictions, conduct requirements, and mandatory repayment conditions with interest if they fail to meet public service work requirements.
dimensions.evidence: requiring recipients who have their scholarship payments stopped or who are not employed in public service for a certain time period to repay their scholarship with 6% interest.

dimensions.assessment: Fiscal effects are limited to the administrative operations of the scholarship foundation and potential repayment collections from specific scholarship recipients.
Amends statute regarding the Harry S. Truman Memorial Scholarship Act, altering governance structure, review panel rules, and transparency mandates.
dimensions.evidence: To make improvements to the Harry S Truman Memorial Scholarship Act, and for other purposes.

dimensions.assessment: Permanent changes to the foundation's structure and ongoing scholarship conditions for future award recipients.
dimensions.evidence: This Act and the amendments made by this Act shall apply only with respect to scholarships awarded... on or after the date of enactment

missing_information: Exact number of future scholarship applicants affected annually
Specific administrative cost estimates for implementing website transparency and panel changes
importance_detail.rationale: The bill reorganizes the Harry S. Truman Scholarship Foundation, changing trustee structures, scholarship criteria, review panels, repayment rules, and transparency requirements for future awardees. The direct effects are limited to scholarship applicants, foundation staff, and board members.
